name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's path to motorsport wasn't direct. He originally trained as a mechanical engineer, working in the automotive industry, focusing on production line efficiency. He quickly realized that his passion lay in the pursuit of perfection, not just volume. A chance encounter with a touring car team at a local track sparked a new direction. Ricardo became obsessed with the intricate details of racing machines and the relentless drive for incremental improvements.

He thrives on identifying flaws and implementing solutions that push the boundaries of performance. Ricardo's quality control ethos is built on meticulous analysis and a relentless pursuit of data-driven insights. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement, where every team member is empowered to contribute to the pursuit of excellence. He is known for his ability to bridge the gap between engineering theory and practical application on the track.

Ricardo's distinctive approach is his emphasis on preventative measures. He aims to catch problems before they manifest on the track, saving the team valuable time and resources. He is also regarded as a mentor, patiently guiding junior engineers to adopt his meticulous approach.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Insists on checking every component himself, regardless of existing protocols.
